parameters.jsCode: const staticData=$getWorkflowStaticData('node');staticData.sentHistory=staticData.sentHistory||[];const results=[];const now=new Date();const todayStr=now.toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Europe/Paris'});const today=new Date(todayStr);today.setHours(0,0,0,0);const items=$input.all();let bookings=[];if(items.length>0&&items[0].json.bookings){bookings=items[0].json.bookings;}else if(items.length>0){bookings=items.map(i=>i.json);}for(const b of bookings){if(!b.startTime||b.status!=='ACCEPTED')continue;const rdvDateRaw=new Date(b.startTime);const rdvParisStr=rdvDateRaw.toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Europe/Paris'});const rdvParis=new Date(rdvParisStr);const rdvDateOnly=new Date(rdvParis.getFullYear(),rdvParis.getMonth(),rdvParis.getDate());const diffDays=Math.round((rdvDateOnly.getTime()-today.getTime())/(1000*60*60*24));let emailType=null;if(diffDays===3)emailType='proof_j3';else if(diffDays===1)emailType='proof_j1';if(!emailType)continue;const bookingId=b.id||b.uid;const uniqueKey=bookingId+'_'+emailType;if(!staticData.sentHistory.includes(uniqueKey)){const attendee=b.attendees?.[0]||{};const name=attendee.name||b.title||'Client';const email=attendee.email||b.responses?.email;if(email&&email.includes('@')){results.push({json:{email:email,firstName:name.split(' ')[0],rdvDate:rdvParis.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long'}),rdvTime:rdvParis.toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}),emailType:emailType,meetingLink:b.meetingUrl||b.metadata?.videoCallUrl||''}});staticData.sentHistory.push(uniqueKey);}}}if(staticData.sentHistory.length>500)staticData.sentHistory=staticData.sentHistory.slice(-500);return results;
